const rows:any[]=[];let h:any;
const run=async(name:string,f:()=>Promise<any>)=>{try{const observed=await f();rows.push({name,status:'PASS',observed});console.log('PASS',name);}catch(e:any){rows.push({name,status:'FAIL',error:e.stack});console.log('FAIL',name,e.message);}await writeFile('audit/h6-002/results-'+(process.env.ATTEMPT??'01')+'.json',JSON.stringify(rows,null,2)+'\n');};
const at=()=>new Date().toISOString();
const snapshot=async()=>{const out:any={};for(const {tablename:t}of await h.observer`select tablename from pg_tables where schemaname='crm_private' and tablename~'^(b03_|b04_|b05_|b07_|identity_)' order by tablename`)out[t]=(await h.observer.unsafe(`select coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(t)::text,E'\n' order by to_jsonb(t)::text),'') v from crm_private.${t} t`))[0].v;return out;};
const deny=async(f:()=>Promise<any>)=>{const before=await snapshot();await assert.rejects(f);assert.deepEqual(await snapshot(),before);};
async function build(accepted=true){
 const opp=h.input();await h.adapter.apply(await h.auth(),write,opp);
 const proof=async(claim:string,coverage:string,time=at())=>{const q=h.req('evidence',{claim,coverage,certainty:'reviewed',source_kind:'manual'},opp.targetId);await h.evidence.apply(await h.auth(),write,{...q,coverage,occurredAt:time});return q.targetId;};
 const svc=await h.cat('service',{name:'SYNTHETIC independent auditor service',nature:'external'}),unit=await h.cat('unit',{name:'SYNTHETIC group',definition:'fixed'}),form=await h.cat('pricing_form',{name:'SYNTHETIC fixed',definition:'fixed'}),tariff=await h.com('tariff',{label:'synthetic audit',price_state:'confirmed',amount:'900.00',cost_state:'confirmed',cost_amount:'700.00',vat_treatment:'included',unit_revision_id:unit.revision,pricing_form_revision_id:form.revision},svc);
 const mid=id(),line=id(),scope='SYNTHETIC auditor direct accepted scope',terms={version:'AUDIT-TERMS-1',text:'SYNTHETIC exact phone terms; no mandate',sourceRef:'SYNTHETIC audit retained terms'};
 const content={scope,terms,pending:[],modalities:[{id:mid,name:'SYNTHETIC modality',participants:3,independent:true,selectable:true,conditions:'synthetic audit exact',finalPersonPrice:'300.00',manualReason:'SYNTHETIC reviewed',definitive:true,lines:[{id:line,serviceRevisionId:svc.revision,unitRevisionId:unit.revision,tariffRevisionId:tariff.revision,quantity:'1',included:true,independent:false,selectable:false,date:null,datePending:true,priceBasis:'fixed',costMaterial:true,sourceRef:'SYNTHETIC auditor line'}]}]};
 const proposalId=id(),versionId=id(),acceptanceId=id(),accepterId=id(),designationId=id();
 await h.identities.apply(await h.auth(),write,{action:'create_entity',operationId:id(),targetId:accepterId,kind:'contact',expectedVersion:0,sourceRef:'SYNTHETIC audit',evidenceRef:'SYNTHETIC audit identity',reason:'SYNTHETIC audit',verified:true,displayName:'SYNTHETIC AUDITOR CLIENT'});
 await h.identities.apply(await h.auth(),write,{action:'designate',operationId:id(),targetId:designationId,relatedId:accepterId,contextId:opp.targetId,kind:'primary_contact',expectedVersion:0,sourceRef:'SYNTHETIC audit',evidenceRef:'SYNTHETIC faculty',reason:'SYNTHETIC',verified:true,happenedAt:new Date(Date.now()-1000).toISOString()});
 const rev=async()=>({expectedRevision:Number((await h.observer`select revision from crm_private.b03_proposals where proposal_id=${proposalId}::uuid`)[0]?.revision??0),expectedOpportunityRevision:Number((await h.observer`select revision from crm_private.b03_opportunities where opportunity_id=${opp.targetId}::uuid`)[0].revision)});
 const base={opportunityId:opp.targetId,proposalId,sourceRef:'SYNTHETIC direct phone agreement audit',reason:'SYNTHETIC audit',expectedOpportunityRevision:1};
 const time=at(),p=async(claim:string)=>proof(claim,scope,time),prepare={...base,action:'prepare',operationId:id(),expectedRevision:0,content},fix={...base,action:'fix',operationId:id(),expectedRevision:1,expectedOpportunityRevision:2,versionId};
 const issue={...base,action:'issue',operationId:id(),expectedRevision:2,expectedOpportunityRevision:2,versionId,coverage:scope,at:time,issuance:{issuedAt:time,limits:[]},evidenceId:await p(`offer:issue:${versionId}:${time}:7`)};
 const register={...base,action:'register',operationId:id(),expectedRevision:3,expectedOpportunityRevision:2,versionId,acceptanceId,coverage:scope,at:time,accepterId,designationId,channel:'phone',terms,authorityEvidenceId:await p(`acceptance:authority:${versionId}:${accepterId}:${designationId}`),evidenceId:await p(`acceptance:agree:${versionId}:${acceptanceId}:${accepterId}:phone`)};
 const reviewEvidence:any={};for(const aspect of ['prices','availability','conditions','capacity'])reviewEvidence[aspect]=await p(`offer:review:${versionId}:${acceptanceId}:accept:${aspect}`);
 const verify={...base,action:'verify',operationId:id(),expectedRevision:4,expectedOpportunityRevision:2,versionId,acceptanceId,coverage:scope,at:time,reviewEvidence,won:true};
 const stages:any[]=[{kind:'proposal',command:prepare},{kind:'proposal',command:fix},{kind:'offer',command:issue},...(accepted?[{kind:'acceptance',command:register},{kind:'acceptance',command:verify}]:[])];
 const detail={services:[{id:id(),serviceRevisionId:svc.revision,nature:'external',variant:null,provider:null,place:null,schedule:null,contributions:[{id:id(),lineId:line,modalityId:mid,quantity:'1',attendees:3,certainty:'estimated'}],nights:[]}],participants:[],assignments:[]};
 const hash=(await h.observer`select encode(crm_crypto.digest(convert_to(${JSON.stringify(detail)}::text::jsonb::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex') h`)[0].h;
 const q:any={operationId:id(),bookingId:id(),opportunityId:opp.targetId,acceptanceId,proposalId,versionId,coverage:scope,terms,expectedRevision:accepted?5:3,expectedOpportunityRevision:accepted?3:2,sourceRef:'SYNTHETIC phone audit',reason:'SYNTHETIC audit conversion',evidenceId:await proof(`booking:detail:${acceptanceId}:${hash}`,scope),detail,route:'direct'};
 return {opp,proof,scope,terms,content,proposalId,versionId,acceptanceId,accepterId,designationId,rev,stages,q,register,verify};
}
const apply=async(f:any)=>h.booking.direct(await h.auth(),write,f.stages,f.q);
const count=async(opp:string)=>(await h.observer`select count(*)::int n from crm_private.b04_bookings where opportunity_id=${opp}::uuid`)[0].n;
try{
 h=await isolatedBooking('h6002auditor',61300);
 const migrations=(await readdir('supabase/migrations')).filter(x=>x.endsWith('.sql')).sort();for(const m of migrations.filter(x=>x>bookingMigration))await h.migration.unsafe(await readFile('supabase/migrations/'+m,'utf8'));
 await run('A01 complete68 runtime privileges',async()=>{assert.equal(migrations.length,68);const role=(await h.runtime`select rolsuper,rolbypassrls from pg_roles where rolname=current_user`)[0];assert.deepEqual({...role},{rolsuper:false,rolbypassrls:false});return {migrations:68,role};});
 await run('A02 direct phone chain no fabricated lead send payment confirmation',async()=>{const f=await build(),before=await snapshot();const r=await apply(f);assert.equal(r.id,f.q.bookingId);assert.equal(await count(f.opp.targetId),1);const b=(await h.observer`select * from crm_private.b04_bookings where booking_id=${r.id}::uuid`)[0];assert.equal(b.state,'Pendiente de preparación');assert.equal(b.chain_snapshot.acceptance.accepter_id,f.accepterId);assert.deepEqual(b.chain_snapshot.acceptance.terms,f.terms);assert.equal((await h.observer`select state from crm_private.b03_opportunities where opportunity_id=${f.opp.targetId}::uuid`)[0].state,'Aceptada / Ganada');const after=await snapshot();for(const t of ['b03_leads','b07_facts','b05_payment_operations'])if(t in before)assert.equal(after[t],before[t]);return {booking:r.id,state:b.state,chain:b.chain_snapshot};});
 await run('A03 missing acceptance preparation persists but Booking denied',async()=>{const f=await build(false);for(const s of f.stages){const a=await h.auth();if(s.kind==='proposal')await h.proposal.apply(a,write,s.command);else await h.offer.apply(a,write,s.command);}await deny(async()=>h.booking.apply(await h.auth(),write,f.q));await assert.rejects(h.booking.apply(await h.auth(),write,f.q));assert.equal(await count(f.opp.targetId),0);assert.equal((await h.observer`select count(*)::int n from crm_private.b03_proposal_versions where version_id=${f.versionId}::uuid`)[0].n,1);return {preparationRetained:true,bookings:0};});
 await run('A04 lost response committed retry same identity and changed key conflict',async()=>{const f=await build();await apply(f);const before=await snapshot(),retry=await apply(f);assert.equal(retry.id,f.q.bookingId);assert.deepEqual(await snapshot(),before);await deny(async()=>h.booking.apply(await h.auth(),write,{...f.q,reason:'SYNTHETIC changed material same key'}));return {id:retry.id,replayed:retry.replayed};});
 await run('A05 unauthorized forged unmapped disabled and replay denied',async()=>{const f=await build();await apply(f);await deny(()=>h.booking.apply({} as any,write,f.q));const alien=await verifyAuth({verify:async()=>({subject:id(),sessionId:id(),passwordVerified:true,mfaVerified:true})},id());await deny(()=>h.booking.apply(alien,write,f.q));await h.migration`update crm_private.crm_actors set enabled=false where actor_id=${h.actorId}::uuid`;try{await assert.rejects(h.booking.apply(await h.auth(),write,f.q));await assert.rejects(h.booking.read(await h.auth(),read,f.q.bookingId));}finally{await h.migration`update crm_private.crm_actors set enabled=true where actor_id=${h.actorId}::uuid`;}assert.equal((await apply(f)).id,f.q.bookingId);return {reauthorizedRecovery:true};});
 await run('A06 SQL ordinary roles cannot mutate history nor read private',async()=>{for(const role of ['anon','authenticated']){const c=h.connect(role);await assert.rejects(c`select * from crm_private.b04_bookings`);await assert.rejects(c`select crm_api.booking_read(null,null,null,null,null)`);}await assert.rejects(h.runtime`update crm_private.b03_acceptances set channel='forged'`);await assert.rejects(h.runtime`delete from crm_private.b03_acceptance_history`);return {roles:2,appendOnly:true};});
 await run('A07 late commit fault full T01 T02 T03 rollback recovery',async()=>{const f=await build(),before=await snapshot();await h.admin.unsafe(`create sequence crm_private.aud002_reached;create function crm_private.aud002_fail()returns trigger language plpgsql security definer as $$begin perform nextval('crm_private.aud002_reached');raise exception 'AUD002_LATE';end$$;create constraint trigger aud002_fail after insert on crm_private.b04_history deferrable initially deferred for each row execute function crm_private.aud002_fail()`);try{await assert.rejects(apply(f));assert.equal((await h.admin`select is_called from crm_private.aud002_reached`)[0].is_called,true);assert.deepEqual(await snapshot(),before);}finally{await h.admin.unsafe('drop trigger aud002_fail on crm_private.b04_history;drop function crm_private.aud002_fail();drop sequence crm_private.aud002_reached');}assert.equal((await apply(f)).id,f.q.bookingId);return {lateReached:true,fullRollback:true,recovered:true};});
 await run('A08 human error rectification preserves original and blocks dependent replay',async()=>{const f=await build();await apply(f);const old=(await h.observer`select to_jsonb(a) v from crm_private.b03_acceptances a where acceptance_id=${f.acceptanceId}::uuid`)[0].v,time=at(),error=await f.proof(`acceptance:error:${f.acceptanceId}`,f.scope,time),review=await f.proof(`acceptance:reevaluate:${f.acceptanceId}:Negociación / cambios`,f.scope,time);const q={...f.register,...await f.rev(),operationId:id(),action:'rectify',at:time,evidenceId:error,humanReviewed:true,reevaluation:{destination:'Negociación / cambios',evidenceId:review,dependentEffects:['verification','commercial']}};for(const k of ['accepterId','designationId','channel','terms','authorityEvidenceId'])delete (q as any)[k];await deny(async()=>h.acceptance.apply(await h.auth(),write,{...q,humanReviewed:false}));await h.acceptance.apply(await h.auth(),write,q);assert.deepEqual((await h.observer`select to_jsonb(a) v from crm_private.b03_acceptances a where acceptance_id=${f.acceptanceId}::uuid`)[0].v,old);assert.equal((await h.observer`select count(*)::int n from crm_private.b03_acceptance_rectifications where acceptance_id=${f.acceptanceId}::uuid`)[0].n,1);assert.equal(await count(f.opp.targetId),1);return {original:old,rectification:q.operationId,dependentCommercial:(await h.observer`select state from crm_private.b03_opportunities where opportunity_id=${f.opp.targetId}::uuid`)[0].state};});
 await run('A09 mismatched lineage fake confirmation split and unselectable rejected',async()=>{const f=await build();for(const k of ['acceptanceId','versionId','opportunityId'])await deny(async()=>h.booking.direct(await h.auth(),write,f.stages,{...f.q,[k]:id()}));await apply(f);for(const extra of [{state:'Confirmada'},{paymentState:'Conciliado'},{split:true},{mergeOpportunityId:id()}])await deny(async()=>h.booking.apply(await h.auth(),write,{...f.q,operationId:id(),...extra}));return {forbidden:7};});
 await run('A10 two authorized sessions real lock races both orders single Booking',async()=>{const outcomes=[];for(const reverse of [false,true]){const f=await build();for(const s of f.stages){const a=await h.auth();if(s.kind==='proposal')await h.proposal.apply(a,write,s.command);else if(s.kind==='offer')await h.offer.apply(a,write,s.command);else await h.acceptance.apply(a,write,s.command);}const first=await verifyAuth({verify:async()=>({subject:h.subject,passwordVerified:true,mfaVerified:true})},id()),sessionId=(await new H0005PostgresAdapter(h.runtime,h.f1,h.f2).establish(first)).sessionId,auth2=await verifyAuth({verify:async()=>({subject:h.subject,sessionId,passwordVerified:true,mfaVerified:true})},id());const rt=h.connect('crm_h0_runtime'),b=new H2009BookingAdapter(rt,h.f1,h.f2),guard=h.connect('crm_h0_migration'),watch=h.connect('crm_h0_migration');let release:any,ready:any;const gate=new Promise<void>(r=>release=r),entered=new Promise<void>(r=>ready=r);const held=guard.begin(async(tx:any)=>{await tx`select pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(${'booking:'+f.opp.targetId},0))`;ready();await gate;});await entered;const jobs=[()=>h.auth().then((a:any)=>h.booking.apply(a,write,f.q)),()=>b.apply(auth2,write,{...f.q,operationId:id(),bookingId:id()})];if(reverse)jobs.reverse();const p=jobs.map(x=>x());p.forEach(x=>x.catch(()=>{}));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));const locks=await watch`select locktype,granted,pg_blocking_pids(pid) blockers from pg_locks where locktype='advisory'`;release();await held;const results=await Promise.allSettled(p);assert.equal(await count(f.opp.targetId),1);assert.ok(results.every(x=>x.status==='fulfilled'));assert.equal((results[0] as any).value.id,(results[1] as any).value.id);outcomes.push({reverse,locks,result:results.map((x:any)=>x.value)});}return outcomes;});
}finally{if(h)await h.close();}
if(rows.some(x=>x.status==='FAIL'))process.exitCode=1;
